abs_.description: The magnitude (absolute value) of the complex number.
constraints: abs_ and angle must have broadcast-compatible shapes.

angle.description: The angle (in radians) of the complex number.
constraints: abs_ and angle must have broadcast-compatible shapes.

output.description: A complex number (or array of complex numbers) with the same shape as `abs_` and `angle`.

constraints: abs_ and angle must have broadcast-compatible shapes.
angles values must be in range [-inf, inf]
